# NBAPI 1.5.6

## Moonshot/Kimi Codex tool calls

- Reworked the Moonshot `Responses -> Chat Completions` bridge to support Codex namespace, custom, and tool-search tools. Kimi can now participate in the same sub-agent, command execution, and file-editing tool loop used by GPT models.
- Namespace tools are flattened into Moonshot-compatible function names and restored to their original namespace, function name, `call_id`, and arguments on the Responses output path.
- Invalid, overlong, and colliding function names now use stable request-scoped mappings instead of being dropped or sent upstream unchanged.
- Added support for `apply_patch`-style custom tools, `tool_search`, dynamically loaded namespace tools, strict schemas, `tool_choice`, tool history, and paired tool outputs.

## Streaming and failure handling

- Rebuilt the Chat Completions tool-call stream state machine to handle late function names, missing indexes, parallel calls, split arguments, and custom-tool input events.
- Truncated streams and streams without `finish_reason` are no longer silently reported as successful text turns.
- Empty non-streaming `choices` and turns containing only unusable unnamed tool calls now produce explicit conversion failures. `finish_reason=length` remains an incomplete Responses result.

## Retry isolation

- Moonshot conversion now preserves the public Responses relay mode and uses a dedicated marker to route the upstream request to `/v1/chat/completions`.
- Channel retries reset tool mappings and conversion state, preventing one upstream attempt from contaminating the next.

## Compatibility

- No database migration is required.
- Protocol support is now equivalent for the covered Codex tools. Actual tool-selection frequency and accuracy still depend on the Kimi model in use.
